page.overview:
Who is Dualla?

is a captain in the Righteous Brand, commanding troops at the Wuyun Gates. As an NPC, Captain Dualla is played by Matthew Mercer.

Dualla wears the silver and dark-crimson armor of the Righteous Brand. Her hair is a reddish-brown and a bit sun bleached at the tips. She keeps her hair pulled into a high ponytail.
